---
title: "A new class of non-stationary Gaussian fields with arbitrary smoothness on metric graphs"
---

This website is a companion to the paper "A new class of non-stationary Gaussian fields with arbitrary smoothness on metric graphs" by David Bolin, Lenin Rafael Riera Segura, and Alexandre B. Simas.

Visit this [GitHub](https://github.com/leninrafaelrierasegura/GWMFMG) repository for all the necessary files to reproduce the results presented in this website and paper.

Go to the [About](about.html) page for the description of the content of this website.
